t: This place is linked to The Big Breakfast, the British breakfast television programme shown on Channel 4 from 1992 to 2002, and revived from 2021 to 2022. It launched with Chris Evans and Gaby Roslin presenting, and the revival was hosted by Mo Gilligan and AJ Odudu. The show was created by Charlie Parsons, a British television producer, who is best known for creating the Survivor franchise, and who also created The Word. I don't have further detail on what you can see on the spot.
